author.bio: Hello! I am a sci-fi, comedy, and biology nerd! I also love drawing monsters! I’m currently working on Weird Creatures - a zany monster battling board game!
author.name: Spacedodo42

content: You definitely know how to shade well, so if you want to move forwards, a tip I have is to try to use more irregular shapes! Maybe a part of the house is chipped a little, or a brick is a little broken? Either way, nice work!
